headline: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
summary: Google Discover will soon offer an AI chatbot-tuned feed. Users can customize their feed by describing desired content. The AI will learn preferences and remember them for future visits.

headline: Riot is ending development on its League of Legends fighting game
summary: Riot Games is ceasing active development on its fighting game 2XKO. The free-to-play title launched less than a year ago. Low player retention prevented a sustainable path forward.

headline: The Genesis GV90 blows the bloody doors off what’s possible in EV design
summary: Genesis unveiled its new GV90, a full-size, three-row electric SUV. The vehicle boasts some of the wildest designs and features in the auto market. Unique coach-style doors highlight its unconventional luxury.

headline: Mark Zuckerberg bought an Irish castle
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his wife Priscilla Chan purchased an Irish castle. They acquired Strancally Castle and its 440-acre estate. The purchase price is estimated between €20 million and €30 million.

headline: Netflix Reveals New Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Trailer and Images at Anime NYC
summary: Netflix showcased a new trailer and images for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. The reveal took place at Anime NYC. Fans can anticipate more high-octane action and tragedy.

headline: Netflix Confirms Blue Eye Samurai Will End With Third and Final Season
summary: Netflix officially announced Blue Eye Samurai will conclude after its third season. This marks the final chapter for the acclaimed series. Fans will prepare for the show's grand finale.

headline: Netflix Reveals Packed Anime Slate: Full Announcement Rundown, Trailers, and Images
summary: Netflix unveiled a massive anime slate at Anime NYC. This included exclusive trailers for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and The One Piece. Blue Eye Samurai's final season was also part of the announcements.

headline: Double Your PlayStation 5 Storage With This 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for Just $136.39 Shipped
summary: A 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for PlayStation 5 is on sale for $136.39. This offers a significant storage upgrade for PS5 owners. It's considered a near-essential upgrade for the console.

headline: Harry and Meghan's return to UK reignites questions over security
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan's UK return raises fresh security questions. A new decision is needed on their publicly funded protection level. Their surprise announcement triggers an official review.

headline: Watch: What does Harry's return mean for his fractured relationship with William?
summary: Prince Harry's return sparks speculation about his relationship with William. The brothers have had a fractured dynamic for years. Their reunion will intensify public interest in their bond.

headline: El Niño set to be 'strongest in living memory', says Met Office
summary: The Met Office predicts El Niño will be the strongest in living memory. Scientists deem the growing weather pattern an 'unprecedented event'. 2027 is projected to be the world's hottest year on record.

headline: French becoming more effective in stopping small boat crossings, UK says
summary: France is improving its effectiveness in stopping small boat crossings, according to the UK. The Home Office credits new tactics implemented this summer. Hundreds of potential crossings have been intercepted.
